world_height_definition: The same Paladin as sprites/paladin-crusader (a person = 1.0); these four are art poses with their light effects baked in, so the figure is only part of each canvas.
source: Paladin's Holy Arts Sprite Sheet.png (claude-paladin-art-cut, Anchor BD as CU)
note: Nothing in web/combat reads size_class or world_height yet. The canvases include the glow, so a draw scale taken from the canvas height would shrink the figure.
